newsitem.title: USA: Steris stock plunges on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Steris stock plunges on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of Steris Corp., a maker of cleaning and sterilisation equipment for the healthcare industry, lost nearly 22 percent of it value Wednesday after warning that its quarterly results would fall below Wall Street estimates.
Steris sank $9 to $29 in late trading on the Nasdaq.

Steris Chairman Bill Sanford said Wall Street's estimates were overly optimistic since many analysts did not accurately forecast results for Amsco International Inc., a company that Steris acquired last year.
Sanford said Amsco had unusually strong results for the December 1995 quarter and analysts had expected that performance to be repeated.
Steris said it now expected to earn 38 cents a share on sales of about $150 million for its fiscal third quarter ended Dec. 31, compared with analysts' estimate of 53 cents a share.
"It was a surprise to most people," said Vivian Wohl, an analyst with Robertson Stephens. "The third quarter is normally their strongest quarter."
